  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 17, 2026
  2800 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  DR. THOMAS J. CLARK COMMUNITY CENTER, 9:00 AM

Silissa Uriarte Smith, Chair  Robert Livingstone, Commissioner
Sharleen Higa, Vice Chair  Susan Redfield, Commissioner
Cory Allen, Commissioner  Kasey Schoen, Commissioner
Christopher Chavez, Commissioner

Stephen Scott, Director
Jennifer Roberts, Executive Assistant

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments to
  christine.amaya@longbeach.gov

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 PRESENTATIONS

 Employee of the Month

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  26-55104  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Parks and Recreation
  Commission meeting of Thursday, August 20, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  26-55105  Recommendation to receive and file an update regarding Open Space &
  Recreation Element from the Long Beach Community Development Department.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  26-55964  Recommendation to consider approval of the fee waiver requests outlined in
  Attachment “A” in accordance with the Fee Waiver policy.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  26-55963  Recommendation to approve Special Event Permit Application #26-215 from the
  Long Beach Public Library Foundation, a California nonprofit corporation, to host
  the Grape Expectations Gala at Lincoln Park on September 27, 2026, that will
  include the consumption and sale of alcohol, with parameters determined by the
  Office of Special Events and Filming and the Department of Parks, Recreation and
  Marine; or,

  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 17, 2026

  Determine the proposed activity does not provide sufficient overall public benefit
  and deny Special Event Permit Application #26-215 from the Long Beach Public
  Library Foundation, a California nonprofit corporation, to host the Grape
  Expectations Gala at Lincoln Park on September 27, 2026. (District 1)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55962  Recommendation to approve Special Event Permit Application #26-368 from
  Partners of Parks, a California nonprofit organization, to host a fundraiser titled
  “Sowing the Seeds,” at El Dorado Nature Center on September 28, 2026, that
  includes the sale and consumption of alcohol beverages, with parameters
  determined by the Office of Special Events and Filming and the Department of
  Parks, Recreation and Marine; or,

  Determine the proposed activity does not provide overall public benefit and deny
  Special Event Permit Application #26-368 from Partners of Parks, a California
  nonprofit organization, to host a fundraiser titled “Sowing the Seeds,” at El Dorado
  Nature Center. (District 4)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-56062  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to
  execute a Revokable Use and Right-of-Entry Permit, and any other necessary
  documents including any amendments, with the Downtown Long Beach Alliance, a
  California non-profit corporation, for the coordination and administration of
  community activities at East Village Arts Park, located at 150 Elm Avenue, for a
  term of one year, with three one-year renewal options at the discretion of the
  Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine. (District 1)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-55965  Recommendation to receive and file the monthly “Director’s Highlights” for
  September 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-55966  Recommendation to discuss potential agenda items for future Parks and
  Recreation Commission meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Parks and Recreation Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker
is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
